context: Daichi and Sho discuss train trip details.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: しょう、詳細、本当、調べたで。
lines.en: Sho, I looked into all the details for you, mate.
lines.style: Kansai lilt lifting the opening. Warm, generous tone—the brightness of a man sharing good news with someone he genuinely cares about. Relaxed pace, no rush. Real affection threading through.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、本当、楽しみ、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah—really looking forward to it. Really.
lines.style: Small voice, but solid. Quiet sincerity underneath the words. Soft repetition on the second 'really'—not doubt, but emphasis, like he's making sure the grown-up knows how much this matters.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: It's going to be fun together, isn't it.
lines.style: Kansai warmth and directness. Unguarded tenderness—not performing for the kid, but genuinely moved by this moment. Steady pace, the weight of meaning held lightly in his voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm going to do my best. I will.
lines.style: Determined but small. The certainty of a six-year-old making a promise to someone he trusts. Soft attack, then steady conviction on the final phrase. No performance—just pure commitment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: That makes me really happy. It really does.
lines.style: Kansai warmth deepening into something genuine and vulnerable. The second phrase slower, quieter—like he's letting the kid see how much this moment means. Breath of real emotion held steady.
